messages.subject: viewing entire files
parts: Is it possible to view the entire methylRaw object file and also save it for finding overlap with enhancers etc.?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: viewing entire files
parts:
you can use getData() function to get the data frame out of the object, that will allow you to view all the rows but it is not feasible to do that with large number CpGs.

For the second part of your question, you can convert the methylKit objects to GRanges objects from GenomicRanges package to do the overlaps. See "methylKit convenience functions" section of the methylKit vignette.

Best,
Altuna
